newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end mixed, U.S. attack impact limited.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end mixed, U.S. attack impact limited.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed mixed on Wednesday and brokers said the impact of the second U.S. missile attack on Iraq was marginal, although the news initially jolted the market and pulled the Nikkei average down close to its key 20,000 level in late morning.
The 225-share Nikkei average closed 3.72 points or 0.02 percent higher at 20,201.87. But its September futures shed 60 points to finish at 20,190.
"There was little reaction in the market to the (second U.S.) attack; the market was fairly calm," said Hisao Suzuki, deputy general manager at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
